```yaml
name: Flaky Monitor

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["*"]  # Trigger after any workflow completes (adjust if you want a specific workflow)
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  flaky-monitor:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download test results artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Setup Testspace
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_DOMAIN }}
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Publish test results to Testspace
        run: |
          testspace --config-args="--format=JUnit" test-results/*.xml

      - name: Generate flaky monitor report
        run: |
          # Placeholder for actual flaky monitor logic
          echo "Flaky tests report" > flaky-report.txt

      - name: Upload flaky monitor report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: flaky-report.txt
```
